headline: Vessel struck by unknown projectile 40nm south of Iran's Lavan Island, fire on board, crew safe (Warning 188-26, Oct 30)'
dek: [VERIFIED FACT] UKMTO: a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile on its port side about 40 nautical miles south of Iran's Lavan Island, causing a fire on board; crew reported safe, no environmental impact reported at the time of the notice; vessels advised to transit with caution. [UNVERIFIED]…
sources: UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) Warning 188-26, Oct 30, via Reuters (Straits Times/SRN carry) and Shafaq
fault_line: Another unnamed ship hit in the Gulf, another fire, no attacker named -- is the shipping war now striking beyond the Strait itself, and why can no one name the ship?
